source.citation: Duvallet, Kerné, Morel & Pigné 2024 Date-Ship-Port triplet data based on AIS data
source.sources_note: AISHUB, NOAA, DMA.DK AIS coverage is incomplete geographically; dataset does not certify complete observation of all possible port links

target_island_source: 51 previously source-eligible landmass IDs, 194 2019 WPI indexed ports, not a sample selected for 2020 AIS coverage

match_rules.identification: Match AIS source port endpoint coordinates to a single WPI point within radius using WGS84 great-circle distance; if multiple WPI points within radius reject as AMBIGUOUS
match_rules.source_key: AIS port source ID plus coordinates rounded to 0.001°; report duplicate ID if widely dispersed
match_rules.island_ownership: From matched WPI port's frozen landmass_id, never use modern country bilateral shipping as WPI identity
match_rules.edge_definition: an AIS table row with dated source port, destination port and 2020 date, both endpoints matched unambiguously to WPI ports on different islands
match_rules.zero_vs_unknown: only an observed direct link is positive; any unmatched or unobserved edge is UNKNOWN, never certified zero shipping
match_rules.distance_sensitivity: 2km strict,5km primary,10km relaxed. Do not select the best by butterfly-host association

audit_to_collect: number source rows and valid 2020 timestamps
number unique AIS port endpoint locations
number source island nodes / 51 with at least one AIS matched port
distinct observed island-pair links vs 1,275 possible pairs
source island-pair links with actual early/late butterfly or host Jaccard
negative_inference_limits: No 2020 AIS link observed does not imply route absent; AIS geographic coverage/source type can be highly selective
No actual vessel ID/identity, departure date, GBIF position or third-party source row shall be committed
No 2020 AIS exposure is chronologically prior to 2001–2010 initial plant or 2011–2022 first-indexed butterfly records
No direct evidence for colonial-era port-to-port shipping, propagule transportation, butterfly arrival, breeding, or host suitability
